name: Cardboard
_animationsSmokeTest_doc: A1 of ANIMATIONS.md smoke test. Flip `animationsSmokeTest` to `true` and run `bun run build-packs` to enable. With the flag on, `scripts/hello.js` spawns one 'anim_marker' sprite at (4, 4) using the 4-angle × 4-frame `anim_marker` sheet — the hue shifts as the camera walks around it (exercises the angle-selection math) and the centered arrow's brightness pulses through 4 frames (exercises the AnimationSystem). Disabled by default; with the flag off the default pack renders byte-identically to pre-A1.
_eventsDemo_doc: Ev1 of EVENTS.md smoke test. When true, scripts/systems/events-demo.js subscribes to a handful of canonical engine events (scene:loaded, pack:loaded, modal:opened/closed, player:moved (once), weapon:fired) plus the default-pack's pickup:collected and console.logs each fire. Flip `eventsDemo=true` and run `bun run build-packs` to enable. Disabled by default — the events-demo script bundles either way but no-ops when the flag is off.

shaders_example._doc: R4/S3 smoke test (wet floor via Mode 3 hooks — supersedes the S1 wet-world.frag full-shader demo). Rename this key to `shaders` and run `bun run build-packs` to enable. Default ships disabled.

shaders_postpass_example._doc: R4/S4 smoke test (CRT scanlines + barrel distortion + vignette via Mode 2 post-process pass). Rename this key to `shaders` and run `bun run build-packs` to enable. Default ships disabled.

_materialsSmokeTest_doc: M1+M2+M3 of MATERIALS.md smoke test. Flip `materialsSmokeTest` to `true` and run `bun run build-packs` to see ALL THREE tiers light up: (M1) alternate ammo pickups get a per-entity Shader pointing at shaders/ghost-sprite.glsl (translucent green wave); (M2) cells assigned the wet.floor preset in scene3 render with 85% mirror reflectivity via shaders/wet-cell.glsl; (M3) scene2.json declares shaders.worldHooks=shaders/scene-fog.glsl which adds a hot-orange depth-attenuated tint via hook_modifyFinalColor. Disabled by default — with this flag off the engine compiles its pack-default programs and rendering is byte-identical to pre-MATERIALS today, even though the wet.floor preset and scene2.json shaders block are still in the pack (they're inert until the flag flips).
